# Threadly

> Threadly is an enterprise GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) intelligence platform. It monitors how AI assistants - ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini - mention and cite a brand when buyers ask questions, and tracks that visibility over time.

## What Threadly does

- Tracks a set of buyer questions (for example "best CRM for small teams") and asks every configured AI provider on each scan.
- Records per-question results: whether the brand was mentioned, whether the brand's domain was cited, the brand's position among mentioned brands, which competitors were mentioned, and the exact citations each provider returned.
- Builds trends, deltas and history from every run so teams can see visibility change over time.
- Scans run automatically every day, plus unlimited manual scans.

## Providers

- Built-in: ChatGPT (OpenAI), Claude (Anthropic), Gemini (Google).
- Custom: on paid plans, any OpenAI-compatible endpoint (Groq, Together AI, Mistral, or a self-hosted model) can be added as a custom provider.
- Bring your own keys: on Pro and above, teams can connect their own OpenAI, Anthropic or Gemini API keys. Keys are encrypted with AES-256-GCM and never shown again after saving.

## Plans

- Starter, Pro, Growth and Enterprise. Seats included per plan: 1, 5, 25 and unlimited.
- Early access: every plan is currently free; billing will be announced before it switches on.
